text:
maya: Quick bakeoff update — ran GPTQ / AWQ / INT8 across Llama-2-13b-chat, Mistral-7b-instruct, and Qwen-1.5. High level: AWQ looks like the best cost/quality trade on Mistral, GPTQ still highest throughput for Llama, Qwen had unstable GPTQ runs with a couple of regressions. Full numbers below and a suggested rollout profile.

sam: Nice, can you post the delta numbers? e.g., MMLU / HellaSwag / Lambada?

maya: Sure — these are deltas vs FP16 baseline (higher is better for MMLU/HellaSwag, lower is better for perplexity). All numbers are averages across 3 seeds.

maya: Llama-2-13b-chat:
- GPTQ-4bit: MMLU -0.9%, HellaSwag -1.4%, Lambada PPL +3.2%
- AWQ-4bit: MMLU -1.6%, HellaSwag -2.0%, Lambada PPL +4.7%
- INT8 (LLM.int8): MMLU -0.4%, HellaSwag -0.8%, Lambada PPL +1.8%
Throughput (tokens/s, single V100-equivalent): GPTQ ~720, AWQ ~610, INT8 ~540. Memory: GPTQ 9.2GB, AWQ 7.6GB, INT8 11.3GB.

maya: Mistral-7b-instruct:
- AWQ-4bit: MMLU -0.3%, HellaSwag -0.7%, Lambada PPL +1.2%
- GPTQ-4bit: MMLU -1.1%, HellaSwag -1.8%, Lambada PPL +3.0%
- INT8: MMLU -0.9%, HellaSwag -1.3%, Lambada PPL +2.5%
Throughput: AWQ ~980, GPTQ ~830, INT8 ~720. Memory: AWQ 5.0GB, GPTQ 6.8GB, INT8 9.6GB.

maya: Qwen-1.5:
- GPTQ-4bit: MMLU -2.8% (one run had -5.6% outlier), HellaSwag -3.4%, Lambada +6.5% (unstable)
- AWQ-4bit: MMLU -1.0%, HellaSwag -1.5%, Lambada +2.1%
- INT8: MMLU -0.6%, HellaSwag -0.9%, Lambada +1.9%
Notes: GPTQ quant failed on two attention patterns (stack overflow in kernel) — we flagged model file and retried, still noisy.

kevin: Are these runs using our new KV cache optimizations?

maya: Yes: continuous batching enabled + KV-cache persistent between requests for the perf numbers. For correctness metrics KV cache only affects perf, not eval. We also used sequence len 512 for LM evals.

eval-bot: Eval summary uploaded — link: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/evals/2026/1823456789/summary.csv :white_check_mark:

henry: Quick deployment recommendations based on this: 
- Hosted (low-latency multi-tenant): Mistral -> AWQ-4bit (best memory + small quality delta). Llama -> INT8 for hosted (safer quality, still good perf)
- Dedicated (reserved GPU): Llama -> GPTQ-4bit on dedicated nodes for max throughput.
- Private/on-prem: Qwen -> AWQ for now, gate GPTQ until we root-cause the kernel instability.

diane: What about rollback thresholds? Our standard is 1.5% MMLU drop tolerated for canary. Is that still okay?

maya: Proposed gating:
- Canary pass if MMLU delta >= -1.0% AND no dataset shows > -2.5% regression.
- Auto-rollout only if throughput increase >= 10% or memory decrease >= 25% relative to baseline, AND canary pass.
- If any single eval task drops >3% we block and open a regression ticket.

sam: For Llama on GPTQ you saw throughput win but memory was 9.2GB. Is padding/KV layout the cause?

\maya: Mostly the packing format in our GPTQ kernels — we can squeeze another ~0.4GB by forcing contiguous KV but that costs ~6% perf. Tradeoff we discussed.

kevin: Can you paste the inference config we used for the AWQ Mistral run?

maya: Yep:
```json
{ "model": "mistral-7b-instruct-awq-4bit", "quant_backend": "awq", "batch_size": 8, "max_seq_len": 512, "kv_cache": true, "scheduler": "continuous-batching" }
```

henry: Any notable qualitative regressions?

maya: A few short-context arithmetic failures for GPTQ Llama runs (simple addition prompts), but examples are small. Qwen GPTQ had hallucination increase on a small legal QA subset — that's why we recommend blocking GPTQ for Qwen until kernel fixes.

diane: Should we update model catalog tags? e.g., `recommended: mistral-awq-hosted` etc.

maya: Yes — I'll push a catalog patch after we merge the eval PR. Suggested tags: `mistral-7b:awq-4bit:recommended-hosted`, `llama-2-13b:gptq-4bit:recommended-dedicated`, `qwen-1.5:awq-4bit:experimental`.

sam: Thanks — can you open the rollout / canary PR? I'll review once you add the eval CSV.

maya: On it, PR coming in ~30m. Thanks all :rocket:
